authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/tastychips/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/tastychips/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI Command Table ("Generated from src/midi.rs enum Nrpn (firmware 1.8.0)."), on the channel variable: a row numbered 0 - 127 its control change, one above 127 its NRPN (CC 99, CC 98, then the value on CC 6, and on CC 38 too where its range goes past 127). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

An NRPN-only row's value is the 7-bit value its range prints, on CC 6 alone: the manual says NRPNs take "the normal 7 bit MIDI values, but also use 14 bit values if necessary", and does not say how a row's printed range maps onto 14 bits. A range past 127 (the scan positions' 0–16383, the sequencer slew's 0–1000 ms) is sent as 14 bits, as printed. The controllers 0 - 127 are also NRPNs with 14-bit values, the manual says; this profile sends them as control changes.

How each row's values were read: 327 printed, 28 named values, 84 range, 1 rate divisions, 3 bands, 2 mod sources, 6 mod destinations. A row read as "printed" has a range that is not numbers (a unit, a sweep, nothing): it is sent 0 - 127, and its description carries what is printed.
The manual's NRPN example ("parameter 2 (sample position) … 16181") is the GR-1's: in this table, 2 is Pitchbend range. It is not used as a vector.
A control change reaches 0 - 127, so these lists stop there; the values past it are not reachable by the controller: CC 82 MOD LIST ROW DESTINATION (mod destinations 128 - 164, SAT GAIN to MACRO10).

Left out, MIDI's own messages: 0 BANK CHANGE, 6 NRPN VAL MSB, 38 NRPN VAL LSB, 98 NRPN PAR LSB, 99 NRPN PAR MSB, 100 RPN PAR LSB, 101 RPN PAR MSB, 120 ALL SOUND OFF, 121 RESET CCS, 122 LOCAL KEY OFF, 123 ALL NOTES OFF, 126 MONO MODE, 127 POLY MODE.
Left out, the performance controllers: 1 MOD WHEEL, 33 MOD WHEEL LSB, 64 SUSTAIN, 74 MPE TIMBRE MSB, 106 MPE TIMBRE LSB.
Left out, actions, which take any value: 41 REC SAMPLE.
Left out, rows the table marks for the other model: 1153 LP SLOPE, 1154 HP SLOPE.
